phase.name: Trial-3 two-component coupled radial ODE derivation

intent: Freeze the coupled radial-ODE template implied by the already frozen post-photon 2x2 nontransverse form and the two-component ansatz from the expert note.

formulas.fourier_space_quadratic_form: M(omega,k) = [[k^2 + 4 lambda v^2 / Z_P, -omega k], [-omega k, omega^2]]
formulas.two_component_ansatz: delta P_0(r,t) = f_0(r) exp(i omega t), delta P_i^L(r,t) = f_L(r) r_hat_i exp(i omega t)
formulas.dimensionless_radius_rule: x = m_base r, beta = omega / m_base
formulas.pilot_radial_ode_f0: f_0'' + 2 f_0'/x + (beta^2 - 4) f_0 + C_ell(beta,x) f_L + (3 rho + rho^2) f_0 = 0
formulas.pilot_radial_ode_fL: f_L'' + 2 f_L'/x - ell(ell+1) f_L / x^2 + beta^2 f_L + C_ell(beta,x) f_0 + (3 rho + rho^2) f_L = 0

rows.metric: Trial-3 two-component coupled radial ODE derivation complete
rows.note: The coupled radial-ODE template is frozen from the post-photon 2x2 basis.
The pivot keeps the kinetic mixing implied by the post-photon nontransverse 2x2 form.

rows.metric: radial mass formula inherited from current canon
rows.note: The radial/time-like mode keeps m_0^2 = 4 lambda v^2 / Z_P in the dimensionless pilot bookkeeping.

rows.metric: two-component ODE introduces no new free parameters
rows.note: The coupling proxy is built only from beta and ell and does not add a new tunable constant.

post_photon_quadratic_form_formulas.quadratic_form_matrix: M(omega,k) = [[k^2 + 4 lambda v^2 / Z_P, -omega k], [-omega k, omega^2]]
post_photon_quadratic_form_formulas.eigenvalues: lambda_±(omega,k) = 1/2[(omega^2 + k^2 + 4 lambda v^2 / Z_P) ± sqrt((omega^2 - k^2 - 4 lambda v^2 / Z_P)^2 + 4 omega^2 k^2)]
